aboutPage.heroText: We are passionate about discovering the most beloved international sweets and drinks, which we bring directly to the Republic of Moldova — authentic, fresh and ready to delight your senses.
aboutPage.storyP1: Everything started from our children. Like all little ones, they always wanted the most colorful and tasty sweets — exactly those bars, candies and special drinks they saw in cartoons or from friends returning from vacations. The problem was that these were almost impossible to find in Moldova.
aboutPage.storyP2: We searched through dozens of stores and still couldn't find the flavors our children wanted. Then we had an idea: if we want these sweets so much for our children, surely other parents and children want the same thing.
aboutPage.storyP3: That's how Challenge Store was born — from a simple and sincere desire to bring the joy of sweets from all over the world closer to families in Moldova. Today we bring hundreds of original products from USA, Japan, Korea, China and Europe, carefully chosen so that every child (and every parent) can find their favorite flavor.
aboutPage.valuesSub: The principles that underlie every decision and every product we bring to you.
aboutPage.value1Text: We bring original products directly from authorized distributors from around the world.
aboutPage.value2Text: Every product goes through strict checks for freshness and compliance.
aboutPage.value3Text: Fast delivery throughout Moldova, directly to your door in the shortest time.
aboutPage.value4Text: We love what we do — we share flavors that bring joy to our customers.
aboutPage.uniqueText: We're not just a store — we're your gateway to authentic world flavors, with quality guaranteed at every step.
aboutPage.unique1Text: From KitKat and Snickers to exotic Asian drinks.
aboutPage.unique2Text: USA, Japan, Korea, China and the best European brands.
aboutPage.unique3Text: Fast courier and safe packaging for every order.
aboutPage.unique4Text: We only collaborate with official partners for 100% original products.
aboutPage.timeline1Text: We opened our doors with the first Challenge Store in Portmall, Chișinău.
aboutPage.timeline2Text: We brought the favorite sweets to the heart of the capital, in the city center.
aboutPage.timeline3Text: We opened a new store in Bălți, closer to the children there.
aboutPage.timeline4Text: We celebrate one year since establishment, together with you.
aboutPage.commitIntro: Every product in our store meets the highest standards of quality and authenticity.
aboutPage.ctaText: Explore our collection of international sweets and drinks and let yourself be surprised by the flavors of the world.
